cover.headline: A Texas Barbecue: Gators Flip The Script — And Jones Changes The Conversation
cover.dek: Florida went into Austin with a backup quarterback making his first career start and left with a 27-24 win over No. 7 Texas.

damage.title: How Florida won it
damage.dek: Florida trailed 17-3 in the second quarter, then outscored Texas 24-7 the rest of the way. The Gators never turned it over.

stats.label: Florida's run
stats.detail: After falling behind 17-3, Florida scored the next 24 points

scoring.title: How the points came
scoring.dek: Texas led 10-0 after one quarter and 17-3 in the second. Florida scored the next 24 points.

flow.summary: Line chart of Florida's win probability against Texas. It starts near 12%, falls to 4% when Texas goes up 17-3 in the second quarter, climbs to 22% when Florida ties it at 17 in the third quarter, reaches 93% at 27-17 in the fourth, dips to 63% after Texas cuts it to 27-24, jumps to 87% on Myles Graham's sack and reaches 100% at the end.

quotes.title: Sumrall and Jones on the win

items.text: They executed with more detail, more urgency, more violence, more strength. They finally took it upon themselves to play with that mentality.
items.role: Florida coach, postgame news conference, as reported by Franz Beard

items.text: We kept fighting. We didn't do that the past couple of weeks, to be honest with you.
items.role: Florida coach, as reported by Buddy Martin

items.text: I didn't take it any bigger than it was. It feels great, but this is just the start. It's not over.
